producer_report.summary: Drain now counts only landings that changed the outcome, and its source check compares the page's statements with the pinned source. (1) A landing whose diff touches nothing the explainer is built from (studies/, the site generator, the pages workflow, explainer docs) is reported as "landed (did not change the outcome)". No rating after only such landings can stop drain as "target met". (2) The pinned-source check is now a budget-guarded model call over the page's statements and the pinned source. It fails on any statement the source contradicts or omits, and it names the statement. The old self-consistency check stays as a floor. The source check's cost is added to spent_usd, and if its cap does not fit, drain stops as "budget spent". Docs, `--help`, decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md are updated. This send-back needed no code change. Criteria 1 and 2 already had passing tests, and I re-ran them, as well as the full `cargo test --locked`, which passes. I did not re-run fmt or clippy in this round.

checks_run.note: Run with --quiet in the final pass; every suite reports ok, 0 failed (a few tests are marked ignored).

criteria_check.criterion: With a stubbed Steps, a drain whose only landing changed nothing the explainer is built from (the job's changed paths are outside studies/, the site generator and the page sources) and whose rating reaches the target does not stop as "target met"; it keeps running or stops for another reason, and the report says the landing did not change the outcome. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `a_landing_that_changed_nothing_the_page_is_built_from_cannot_meet_the_target` in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs passes in `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` (24 passed). It asserts the report text contains "did not change the outcome" (tests/drain.rs lines 401-404). The text comes from drain.rs line 512 and display.rs line 293. Unit test `only_a_diff_touching_what_the_page_is_built_from_changes_the_outcome` covers `changes_outcome`.

criteria_check.criterion: With a stub, a landing whose changed paths include a study file or the site generator, followed by a rating at the target and a passing source check, still stops as "target met" (the happy path is not broken). Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `a_landing_that_changed_a_study_file_or_the_site_generator_still_meets_the_target` passes. `two_items_are_landed_and_then_a_rating_of_four_meets_the_target` and `a_rating_at_the_target_stops_drain_only_with_a_passing_source_check` also pass. The full `cargo test --locked` passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A regression test feeds the source check a page statement that the pinned source contradicts (teardown can reopen instead of close; yolo-on allows self-merge; the wrong handoff frees a place) and another that leaves out a fact the source states; the check fails for each and names the statement, so the rating cannot end the run. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: The regression tests in drain.rs and tests/drain.rs pass under `cargo test --locked`. This round I did not re-read their bodies, so the evidence is that they pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The model-backed source check is guarded by the budget like other model calls: when its cap does not fit, drain stops as "budget spent" instead of counting the target as met, and its cost is added to spent_usd. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.

`Stop::TargetMet` meaning, the module docs, `athena drain --help`, and a new decision in docs/decisions.md state both rules and the alternatives (the old self-consistency check is kept as a floor), and CHANGELOG.md records the change.
criteria_check.evidence: The module docs in drain.rs (about line 20) and the help text in main.rs (about line 193) state the rules. `drain_help_documents_the_flags_and_lists_every_stop_reason` passes. The decision entry in docs/decisions.md and the CHANGELOG.md entry were written earlier in this job. I did not re-read them this round.
